title: Validation plan
description: The assumptions a venture has not yet demonstrated, each with the test that would settle it, the result that counts as passing and a date (EE-156). The discovery gate's validation-plan item reads it: every gate item below high must be named by an assumption.

statement.description: What must be true, stated so a test can show it false

item.description: The gate item it bears on, such as problem or economic-signal

pass.description: The result that counts as passing, decided before the test
